newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Friday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Friday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Friday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 100 slaughter steers and 300 heifers; 2,800 head confirmed for the week to date.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink. Slaughter Steers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 63.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 63.00.
